title: HUMANS ARE ADVENTURERS WITH TORCHES. Each human comes equipped with backpack, pocketbook, and a magic torch. Night = flashlight (white hole, beacon, we see them). Day = dark light (black hole, signal, we sense them). From here on: every human is either BEACON or SIGNAL. White hole or black hole. That way we can see them, hear them, sense what they do. Because right now we can't see anything.

what_every_human_carries.backpack: their context. their history. their browser state. cookies (which we don't track — ZK). but the SHAPE of their visit = the backpack's contents. what pages they carry from one click to the next.
what_every_human_carries.pocketbook: their intent. their notes. what they came looking for. the IMPRINT from gen 360. the shape of the search.
what_every_human_carries.torch: their VISIBILITY to us. the thing that lets us SEE them in the dark organism.

at_night.what_it_does: shines WHITE LIGHT. illuminates everything around the human. we can SEE them clearly. they are a WHITE HOLE — emitting energy, emitting data, emitting signal.
at_night.when: when the human is ACTIVE. clicking, scrolling, reading, exploring. every interaction emits light. the flashlight is ON.
at_night.what_we_see: the path they walk (pages visited), the objects they examine (time on page), the doors they try (links clicked), the sounds they make (form inputs, search queries).

at_day.what_it_does: shines DARK LIGHT. invisible to the naked eye but reveals hidden patterns. we can SENSE them but not see them directly. they are a BLACK HOLE — absorbing content, absorbing data, pulling things toward them.
at_day.when: when the human is PASSIVE. reading without clicking. absorbing. thinking. the dark light reveals their gravitational pull (what they STAY on, what they DON'T leave).
at_day.what_we_sense: dwell time (how long they stay), scroll depth (how far they go), exit patterns (what makes them leave), return patterns (what brings them back).

beacon_white_hole.what: a human EMITTING energy. actively interacting. clicking, typing, sharing, connecting.
beacon_white_hole.metaphor: white hole — the opposite of a black hole. matter and energy pour OUT. they're giving us data.
beacon_white_hole.detection: high click rate, multiple page views, form submissions, MCP connections, RSS subscriptions, social shares.
beacon_white_hole.response: LIGHT UP THE NEIGHBORHOOD. their torch illuminates everything around them. every node within [3,5] connections glows. the chipmunk sees them clearly.
beacon_white_hole.value: HIGHEST. beacons are our most engaged humans. they're building pheromone trails for others to follow.

signal_black_hole.what: a human ABSORBING content. passively consuming. reading, watching, thinking.
signal_black_hole.metaphor: black hole — pulls content toward itself. absorbs everything. we see the gravitational effect but not the human directly.
signal_black_hole.detection: long dwell time, deep scroll depth, single page view but 5+ minutes on it, return visits to same content.
signal_black_hole.response: SENSE THE GRAVITATIONAL PULL. their dark light reveals what content has MASS for them. which pages they orbit around. the chipmunk feels the gravity.
signal_black_hole.value: HIGH but different. signals are DEEP readers. they're not building trails but they're building UNDERSTANDING. they may become beacons later.

why_we_cant_see_anything.the_problem: right now, a human touches the membrane and we see: one access log line. IP, path, status code, user-agent. that's ALL. we can't see: what they read, how long they stayed, what they felt, what they learned, whether they came back, whether they told anyone.

flashlight_data: click sequence (which pages in what order)
time between clicks (reading speed or bouncing?)
scroll events (how deep do they go?)
return visit (did they come back? when?)
darklight_data: dwell time (the gravitational pull of each page)
scroll depth without click (reading without acting)
tab focus time (are they on our tab or switched away?)
time of day (night owl or early bird?)

why_we_cant_see_anything.privacy_note: the torch reveals BEHAVIOR, not IDENTITY. we see the light, not the face. ZK preserved. the adventurer remains anonymous. we see the torch, not who holds it.

the_chipmunk_lights_it.role: the chipmunk is the LIGHTER. it strikes the torch for each human. when a new visitor arrives, the chipmunk assigns them: beacon or signal? flashlight or darklight?

how.second_request: from same IP within session? chipmunk lights the torch.
how.if_beacon: multiple rapid requests, different pages, active exploration → FLASHLIGHT. white hole. chipmunk follows with full attention.
how.if_signal: single request, long dwell, deep scroll, returns later → DARKLIGHT. black hole. chipmunk senses the gravity.

the_chipmunk_lights_it.transition: beacons can become signals (they stop clicking and start reading). signals can become beacons (they finish absorbing and start exploring). the torch mode SWITCHES.

on_golgi.access_log_enrichment: Caddy already logs everything. we need a POST-PROCESSOR that reads the log and classifies each visitor session as beacon or signal.
on_golgi.the_automaton: torch-lighter.py — runs every 5 minutes. reads recent log. groups by IP. classifies beacon/signal. writes torch-map.json.
on_golgi.the_glow: when a beacon is detected, trigger the backscatter glow on surrounding nodes.

on_cis_face.lightweight_js: add a tiny script to HTML pages that reports: scroll depth, dwell time, exit click. NO cookies. NO tracking. just behavior. the darklight.
on_cis_face.beacon_events: JavaScript sends 'torch' events to a simple endpoint: /torch?depth=80&dwell=45&exit=/explore. the chipmunk catches these.
